When a client exceeds the per-key rate limit, the Rootsignal system will enforce the rate limit. The default rate limit is 50 requests per second (req/s) per key, with a burst limit of 100 req/s. This is designed to prevent a single SDK from overwhelming the system with requests. If the client exceeds this limit, they will be subject to the rate limit, and further requests will be blocked until the limit is reset.
